# GFR Design Story
<!-- Generated by the gfr-design-story skill -->

> A working document for designers to translate PRDs, meeting transcripts, stakeholder briefs, half-baked stories, and design artifacts into a complete picture of what needs to be designed — before a single pixel is moved.

## 1. Intent & Context

> Define why this exists before defining what it does. A weak intent statement is the most common reason design work gets reworked.

| Field | Your answer |
|---|---|
| What problem is being solved | |
| Who is the primary user | |
| What triggers this flow | _The entry point or initiating event_ |
| Success condition | _The observable signal that this worked_ |

**Supporting evidence**
_Data, research findings, user quotes, support tickets, or session observations that confirm this is a real problem._

_Repeat this table for each screen in the inventory._

**Saffron tech stack reminder**
- React 18 + TypeScript + Vite 5
- Tailwind CSS 3.4 with `saf-*` utilities
- ShadCN/ui base, overridden with Saffron tokens
- Fonts: Clario (headings) · Source Sans 3 (body) · Font Awesome 6 Sharp (icons)
- Component package: `@saffron/core-components`

## 5. Interaction & State Map

> Describe how the user moves through this experience. Think in flows, not screens. Every state must be accounted for.

### Primary flow

[Trigger] → [State change] → [Visual result]

1. _User arrives at [entry point] because…_
2. _They see / encounter…_
3. _They take action…_
4. _The system responds…_
5. _They reach [outcome]_

### Secondary flows

- **Flow A:** _Description_
- **Flow B:** _Description_

### States to design

_Every component or screen that changes based on context. Non-optional._

- [ ] Empty state
- [ ] Loading state
- [ ] Error state
- [ ] Success / confirmation state
- [ ] Disabled state
- [ ] Hover / focus / active states
- [ ] Partial data state
- [ ] Maximum data state (lists, tables at scale)
- [ ] Edge case states (min. 4–5 — see Section 9)

## 8. Constraints & Out-of-Scope

> Non-negotiables that must shape the design. These are not suggestions.

### Technical constraints
_e.g. Must use existing Saffron components. API cannot support real-time updates._

-

### Accessibility requirements
_Must meet WCAG 2.1 AA minimum. Must be operable by keyboard only. Color cannot be the only signal._

-

### Platform / device constraints
_e.g. Desktop-first. Responsive to 768px min._

-

### Legal / compliance / privacy
_e.g. Cannot store PII without consent. Regulated content requires disclaimer._

-

### Explicitly out of scope

- _List what is NOT being designed in this story to prevent scope creep_

## Usage notes

This template is a living document — start it when a PRD drops, a meeting ends, or an artifact lands. It is not a deliverable; it is your thinking surface.

**Minimum viable story:** Sections 1–5 complete before design begins.
**Ready for handoff:** All sections complete, no `[UNRESOLVED]` items remaining.
**Decision log:** One row per conversation where a direction was set.
